verdict_reason: The deletion is a clean rename to AddressController with no dangling references, but the rename left five @Timed metric names and the list query timer on the old Operator vocabulary.

todos.issue: Renaming OperatorController to AddressController stops part-way through the concept's vocabulary: the timers keep the old name. AddressController.java:110 controller.listOperators.time, :233 controller.createOperator.time, :284 controller.getOperator.time, :350 controller.updateOperator.time, :397 controller.deleteOperator.time, and AddressService.java:80 controller.listOperators.query.time. Every class, path variable ({address-id}) and log line now says address, so a metric search for 'address' finds none of these. No dashboard or alert in the repo reads the old names.
todos.fix: Must: every metric this service publishes for the address endpoints and the list query is named for addresses, matching the class, operation ids and path variables. One way: rename the five @Timed values to controller.listAddresses.time, controller.createAddress.time, controller.getAddress.time, controller.updateAddress.time, controller.deleteAddress.time and the service timer to controller.listAddresses.query.time, and update any Grafana panel that queries the old names in the same change.
